// Package mergecasual 是合成与限时挑战的业务消费者；不把棋盘、数值或广告策略加入公共框架。
package mergecasual

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/framework/configdata"
	"io"
)

var ErrRule = errors.New("merge casual: invalid identity, state, operation, revision or limit")

const LedgerLimit = 128
const ValueLimit int64 = 1000000
const MaxTime int64 = 4000000000000

// 配置全部为值类型。玩家棋盘创建时冻结规则，升级存档规则需独立迁移，登录不静默换表。
type Rules struct {
	Version                                                string
	EnergyCap, EnergyMillis, ChargeMillis, ChallengeMillis int64
	UnlockGold, OrderGold, ChallengeGold, AdEnergy         int64
}

func DemoRules() Rules { return Rules{"merge-v1", 10, 3000, 5000, 60000, 5, 20, 30, 2} }
func (r Rules) Validate() error {
	if r.Version == "" || len(r.Version) > 64 || r.EnergyCap < 3 || r.EnergyCap > 100 || r.EnergyMillis < 100 || r.EnergyMillis > 3600000 || r.ChargeMillis < 100 || r.ChargeMillis > 3600000 || r.ChallengeMillis < 1000 || r.ChallengeMillis > 3600000 || r.UnlockGold < 1 || r.UnlockGold > 100 || r.OrderGold < 1 || r.OrderGold > 100 || r.ChallengeGold < 1 || r.ChallengeGold > 100 || r.AdEnergy < 1 || r.AdEnergy > r.EnergyCap {
		return ErrRule
	}
	return nil
}
func (r Rules) Hash() string {
	sum := sha256.Sum256([]byte(encode(r)))
	return hex.EncodeToString(sum[:])
}
func validTime(now int64) bool { return now > 0 && now < MaxTime }
func encode(v any) string {
	raw, err := json.Marshal(v)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	return string(raw)
}
func StrictJSON(raw string, out any) error {
	if len(raw) == 0 || len(raw) > 256*1024 {
		return ErrRule
	}
	d := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewBufferString(raw))
	d.DisallowUnknownFields()
	if err := d.Decode(out); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if d.Decode(new(any)) != io.EOF {
		return ErrRule
	}
	return nil
}
func OpenCatalog(dir string) (*configdata.Store, error) {
	registry := configdata.NewRegistry()
	configdata.MustRegisterObject(registry, configdata.ObjectDef[Rules]{Name: "merge_rules", File: "merge.json", Validate: func(_ *configdata.BuildContext, r Rules) error { return r.Validate() }})
	store := configdata.NewStore(registry, dir)
	_, err := store.Load(context.Background())
	return store, err
}
func CaptureRules(s *configdata.Snapshot) (Rules, error) {
	r, ok := configdata.ObjectFrom[Rules](s, "merge_rules")
	if !ok {
		return Rules{}, ErrRule
	}
	return r, r.Validate()
}
